name: red team: getVestings over 100 vestings of 120 tranches, one page of the dApp's reads, within the public API's query budget
comment: A griefer can send a wallet, or a token, 100 vestings of 120 tranches each (10 EGLD in fees). My vestings and the Token page read them in one getVestings of 100 ids. On the Go VM one such view costs about 96M gas (1,500,000,000 - 1,400,237,721 for one; 15 fit in 1.5B, 16 do not), so a node at the default ShardMaxGasPerVmQuery of 1.5B would refuse the page. The public API answers with a budget of 300B (gasRemaining about 299.99B on both mainnet and devnet, read on 1 Nov 2026), which this step uses: the page is read whole. Pass gas 1 as the fourth argument of the generator to make the runner print the real figure.
